audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read 'Skill' while the whys say 'you out-body Malphite', 'he can't break tether or dodge tentacles, so you dominate' and 'your R field melts his low-armor body'. 2+ items read Illaoi while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say full-tank Malphite stops caring about tentacles.
audit.why: Packet chart is Illaoi for six stages then Malphite; 51.28% over 1601 games is a lane won early and lost to armour stacking.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 4-5 and 6 -> Illaoi; 2+ items -> Malphite; both layers, ratings moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstoppable Force was described only as 'saved for fights' with no cooldown, in a lane whose entire trading section is keyed to it.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s — long enough that a laning Malphite genuinely cannot spend it on chip. Ground Slam is a flat 7s and Seismic Shard a flat 8s, which are the cooldowns that actually gate his trades.
audit.corrected: 130s written into the do's; the reader now knows why 'he saves it' is true rather than being told to assume it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Granite Shield was never mentioned anywhere on the page, Thunderclap's auto-attack reset was never named, and Ground Slam's damage scaling off his own armour was absent while the page told the reader to 'build some armor pen'.
audit.why: Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges if he goes a few seconds without being hit — that is the single reason a committed all-in on a fresh Malphite underperforms, and chipping it off first changes the maths. Thunderclap is an auto reset whose following attacks carry aftershocks, so his damage starts on a wind-up. Ground Slam deals magic damage based on his Armor, which is why his armour stacking is offence as well as defence.
audit.corrected: Granite Shield's 10% absorb and recharge written into key interactions; the Thunderclap reset into the don'ts; Ground Slam's armour scaling into the armour-pen do.

edits.before: Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 and he saves it for fights, not lane.

edits.before: Malphite wastes Unstoppable Force — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Ground Slam's damage scales off his armour, so his tank buy hits back.

edits.before: That is Malphite's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thunderclap opens on an auto reset and the next few hits carry aftershocks.

edits.before: Track Malphite's Unstoppable Force: Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: Granite Shield eats 10% of his max health and recharges if he goes a few seconds untouched — chip it off, then commit.

edits.before: Poke with Q (Seismic Shard) and back off
edits.after: Steal your move speed with Seismic Shard
